scope: Bounded source-universe ledger for selected apps/services/engines/native/tools roots; classification and wrapper edges only.

criticality.rationale: A defensible source denominator is prerequisite to complete MCP coverage but does not itself grant runtime authority.

stpa.rationale: False completeness or classification collapse can hide unsafe unbound services.

fmea.rationale: False executable or MCP-usable claims are severity-floor5; occurrence/detection are analyst estimates.

dependency.rationale: t1 source reconciliation precedes t2 contracts and service adapters; blocked consumers remain ineligible.

impact.rationale: Correct denominator prevents false coverage and directs later adapter work.

fmea_modes.cause: Package, test, wrapper or reference artifact counted as executable service.
fmea_modes.effect: Coverage gaps hidden and unsafe release assumptions.
fmea_modes.controls: Path-qualified records, explicit classifications, wrapper edges, unresolved counts, separate MCP/runtime states.

fmea_modes.cause: Bounded listing treated as complete universe.
fmea_modes.effect: Untracked service or engine remains outside MCP plan.
fmea_modes.controls: Partial completeness flag and unresolved frontier; require authoritative registry reconciliation.

stpa_analysis.control_action: Classify candidate source entries and bind artifact edges

ucas.context: Missing service or executable root is omitted.
ucas.constraint: Reconcile all canonical roots and preserve unknown entries.

ucas.context: Test/wrapper/reference is presented as live service.
ucas.constraint: Classification and runtime usability remain separate.

ucas.context: Stale hashes or prior candidate used.
ucas.constraint: Bind source SHA and current candidate before later claims.
Finite depth/file bounds and Sa-plan lease fence.

decision.summary: Select a bounded candidate-pinned source-universe ledger as the cheapest discriminating t1 frontier. It exposes unresolved denominator gaps without claiming completeness or starting any service.
alternatives: Treat README/manifest declarations as usable services (rejected)
Source-universe ledger with explicit partial status (selected)
counterevidence: No inspected registry defines the complete executable system.
Hermes nested Dune closure, native linkage and unlisted tool entrypoints remain unknown.
assumptions: Root listing and selected source anchors are accurate at observation time.
No production or external-source authority is needed for this development artifact.
decision.forecast: Ledger preserves classifications and unknown MCP/runtime states while preventing denominator shrinkage.
decision.falsifier: Authoritative registry contradicts selected paths or a record lacks required source binding.
acceptance: Every selected record is path-qualified and hash-bound.
Package, executable, library, test, wrapper, placeholder and reference-only classes remain distinct.
Wrapper-to-artifact edges are explicit; tests never become services.
MCP mapping and runtime usability remain UNKNOWN.
Missing and unclassified entries are retained in unresolved.
decision.rollback: Preserve artifact as partial evidence; no live state to roll back.
decision.budget: One writer, bounded read-only review, no package/runtime action.
residuals: Partial bounded universe; no canonical import or operational acceptance.
